interpretationFindings.classification: EVIDÊNCIA DE PRODUÇÃO / leitura contextual dos três GETs
interpretationFindings.freeEntry: All three HTTP representations advertise 30 free credits, every engine unlocked and no card for entry. Paid clean downloads are distinguished from watermarked trial output.
interpretationFindings.pricing: Both pricing representations show Starter USD9.90, Creator USD19.90 and Studio USD39.90 per month and 60/150/300 monthly credits. Their structured offers show the same prices.
interpretationFindings.retiredPaidTrial: No retired one-dollar/80-credit entry offer or absence of free entry was found in the extracted static body and structured offer/FAQ data.
phraseFalsePositives: The card-required substring on Seedance appears inside the negation "no card required", so it is not a card requirement.
The seven-day passage on pricing explicitly concerns a one-time service/pilot, not the retired card-entry trial.
The USD1.50 per-film pack passage is not a USD1 entry fee.
interpretationFindings.remainingCurrencyContradiction: Both pricing representations still say that Kineo lists and charges plan prices in USD worldwide, in the general disclosure and the visible FAQ. This is separate from the trial wording and contradicts the previously verified BRL settlement rule.
interpretationFindings.cacheLimit: All three responses report x-vercel-cache PRERENDER, Age0 and public,max-age=0,must-revalidate. These describe the website HTTP/CDN response only and do not identify the search index/cache or evidence used by ChatGPT. No cache purge or cache-busting request was issued.
